title: Continual SSM skill codes
hypothesis: Sequential acquisition of four related stable dynamics with one shared SSM plus per-skill Mirror coordinates retains earlier skills with <=60% independent transition bytes and <=1.10x independent final error/forgetting.
controls: shared plus rank-one private residual per skill

task.teacher: related stable transitions generated from one base plus skill-specific Givens rotations
task.order: fixed skill order per world; train each skill once, evaluate all seen skills after every stage

development.selection_metric: final-stage mean across-skill trajectory NRMSE plus forgetting

success_gate: Every fresh world: final Mirror mean trajectory NRMSE <=1.10x independent; mean forgetting <=1.10x independent; bytes per skill <=60% independent; all stable.
failure_gate: Any quality/forgetting/byte/stability gate fails or rank-one residual matches with fewer bytes.
boundaries: No learned routing or natural continual benchmark.
Not evidence of continual language-model retention.
